query:
SELECT hs.htlcAddress, hs.rfqId, hs.status as htlc_status,
       sa.status as analytics_status, sa.rfqId as sa_rfqId
FROM htlc_swaps hs
LEFT JOIN swap_analytics sa ON sa.rfqId = hs.rfqId
WHERE hs.htlcAddress LIKE '642LJ3L%';
